# Dexerto

> Dexerto is a comprehensive gaming news and guides platform covering competitive esports, major AAA titles, and emerging gaming trends across PC, console, and mobile platforms.

Dexerto delivers real-time coverage of patch notes, game updates, esports tournaments, and in-depth guides for the most popular games including Call of Duty, Fortnite, Valorant, League of Legends, and Counter-Strike 2. The site serves both casual and competitive gamers with breaking news, strategy guides, and industry coverage.

## Key Topics

- Patch Notes
- Game Guides
- Esports Coverage
- Game Updates
- Call of Duty
- Fortnite
- Valorant
- League of Legends
- Counter-Strike 2
- PC Gaming
- PS5
- Xbox Series X/S
- Nintendo Switch
- Game Reviews
- Gaming News

## Competitive Esports Games

- [Valorant - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/valorant): Valorant news, agent guides, weapon tips, esports from Riot Games
- [Counter-Strike 2 - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/counter-strike-2): CS2 news, guides, esports, skins, pro players coverage by Valve
- [League of Legends - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/league-of-legends): League of Legends news, updates, esports, patch notes by Riot Games
- [Overwatch News - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/overwatch): Overwatch 2 news, guides, patch notes, esports from Blizzard

## Shooter & Action Games

- [Call of Duty - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/call-of-duty): Call of Duty coverage: Warzone, Black Ops 6, esports, weapon guides, patches
- [Apex Legends - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/apex-legends): Apex Legends updates, guides, leaks, esports by Respawn Entertainment
- [Battlefield - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/battlefield): Battlefield news, esports, patch notes, guides, and seasonal content
- [Fortnite - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/fortnite): Fortnite news, patch notes, challenges, weapons, leaks, and guides

## RPG & Adventure Games

- [Genshin Impact - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/genshin-impact): Genshin Impact news, patch notes, guides, codes by HoYoverse
- [Honkai Star Rail - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/honkai-star-rail): Honkai Star Rail updates, guides, builds, leaks by HoYoverse
- [Baldur's Gate - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/baldurs-gate): Baldur's Gate 3 news, guides, tips, mods by Larian Studios
- [Diablo - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/diablo): Diablo 4, Immortal, Resurrected news, guides, builds by Blizzard
- [Destiny - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/destiny): Destiny 2 news, exotic weapon guides, expansions, seasons by Bungie

## Open World & Simulation Games

- [GTA - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/gta): GTA 5, GTA 6, GTA Online news, guides, updates, and patch notes
- [EA SPORTS FC - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/ea-sports-fc): EA FC 26 news, guides for Ultimate Team, Career Mode, RUSH

## Nintendo & Franchise Games

- [Pokemon - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/pokemon): Pokemon news, guides, events, leaks across series and Pokemon Go

## Optional

- [Gaming - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/gaming): Central gaming hub covering PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PC news and guides
- [Roblox - Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/roblox): Roblox game codes, guides, code lists for popular games
